scope: Corollary 2.2 (Two collars around an annulus) of the manuscript “SLE3 universality for weak finite-range Ising interactions” (preprints/SLE3-universality-for-weak-finite-range-Ising-interactions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 44a7837e35328259), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let 2 ≤ r < R/4, A = BR\Br, and W = B2R\Br/2, with integer rounding of the boundaries. Suppose W is an unpinned square-lattice chart. The law on A, conditional on arbitrary spins outside W, has pointwise density relative to µ0|A between K−1 and K, for an absolute K independent of R/r. The assertion applies in a torus chart and to mixtures of exterior conditions. Fixed changes of the two collar ratios only change K.
